name: SparkFun RedBoard Artemis Nano
description: Breadboard-friendly Nano-style board on the ultra-low-power Apollo3 (Cortex-M4F with BLE 5): USB-C, Qwiic, PDM microphone, LiPo charging and 17 interrupt-capable GPIO.
notes: 3.3 V logic only; all 17 GPIO are interrupt capable; 2 UART, 4 I2C and 2 SPI instances available (SparkFun).
Programmed through the on-board USB-serial bridge with SparkFun's Arduino core; 1 MB flash / 384 KB RAM, 48 MHz (96 MHz turbo).
2x5 1.27 mm SWD/JTAG pads and a PDM microphone on the back side.
